name: What is the process for designing and building an ADU?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and building an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ADU design and build process begins with a consultation to assess feasibility and client needs. This is followed by architectural design and planning, including structural and civil engineering. Once plans are finalized, they are submitted to the local planning department for permitting. After permits are issued, construction commences, concluding with final inspections and occupancy approval.
acceptedAnswer.description: The ADU process involves initial consultation, design, permitting, construction, and final inspections.
